# Check this for alternative DMR analysis
https://support.bioconductor.org/p/94211/   

Regulatory Feature Group	Description:
- Promoter_Associated	CpG sites in promoter regions, regulating gene expression.
- Promoter_Associated_Cell_type_specific	CpG sites in promoters active only in specific cell types.
- Gene_Associated_Cell_type_specific	CpG sites in gene bodies or regulatory regions active in specific   cell types.
- Unclassified_Cell_type_specific	CpG sites in cell-type-specific regulatory regions with unclear   function.
- Unclassified	CpG sites in regulatory regions with unknown function.
- "" (Empty String)	CpG sites not associated with any known regulatory feature.

```{r}

                       "Relation_to_Island", "X450k_Enhancer")]
```

# Read GTF file with gene locations
## Search genes for each CpG
Strand in GTF:

- Forward (+):
Transcription proceeds from the 5' → 3' direction.
The TSS (Transcription Start Site) is at the start coordinate of the gene.

- Reverse(-):
Transcription proceeds from the 3' → 5' direction (right to left on the chromosome).
The TSS is at the end coordinate of the gene.

Impact on TSS Distance:
For forward strand (+) genes:
Upstream = positions before the TSS (lower coordinates).
Downstream = positions after the TSS (higher coordinates).

For reverse strand (-) genes:
Upstream = positions after the TSS (higher coordinates).
Downstream = positions before the TSS (lower coordinates).

```{r}
gtf <- read.table('../../docs/genes.gtf', header = FALSE, skip = 5, sep = "\t")
genes.info <- gtf[gtf$V3 == "gene", ]
colnames(genes.info) <- c(
  "seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", 
  "score", "strand", "frame", "attribute"
)

df <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(genes.info$attribute, ';', 7))
ENS.ID <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V1, ' ', 2))$V2
gene.symbol <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V4, ' ', 3))$V3

genes.info$ENS.ID <- ENS.ID
genes.info$gene.symbol <- gene.symbol
genes.info$attribute <- NULL
head(genes.info)
```

# Retrieve all the genes +- 1Mb from CpG position

Some ideas reinforced:
1. Rational Window Sizes for Gene Mapping
Promoter-Focused (Immediate Regulatory Control):
  - Use ±1,500–5,000 bp from the CpG site.
  - This captures:
    - Core promoters (where transcription machinery binds, typically within ±2,000 bp      of TSS).
    - Proximal enhancers (often within 5 kb upstream of TSS).

Why this works: >80% of promoter-associated CpGs fall within 1.5–2 kb of TSS, 
and 95% within 5 kb. This minimizes noise while covering key regulatory regions.

Gene Body + Proximal Regulatory (Balanced Approach):
  - Use ±20,000 bp (20 kb). This includes:
  - Promoters, first exons/introns (highly correlated with expression).
  - Nearby enhancers or insulator elements (typically within 20 kb).
  - Advantage: Captures >70% of functionally linked CpG-gene pairs while excluding
    distant genes.

2. Step-by-Step Strategy to Refine Mappings

A. Prioritize Genomic Annotations
Annotate CpGs using databases like:
- Illumina's manifest files (e.g., IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19).
- UCSC/ENSEMBL for gene coordinates (TSS, TES, exons).

Regulatory databases: ENCODE (promoters/enhancers), FANTOM5 (permissive enhancers), or Roadmap Epigenomics.

Filter mappings to:
- CpGs in promoters (TSS ± 2 kb).
- CpGs in 5′ UTRs/first exons (strongly linked to expression).
- CpGs in enhancers overlapping H3K27ac/H3K4me1 marks (use public ChIP-seq data).

```{r}
find.near.genes <- function(DMPS.annot) {
  df.genes.close.to.cpgs <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(DMPS.annot)) {
    print(paste0("Searching genes for CpG: ", i) )
    gene.selection <- genes.info %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        seqname == DMPS.annot[i, "chr"],
        start %in% (
          DMPS.annot[i, "pos"][[1]] - 1000000):(DMPS.annot[i, "pos"][[1]] + 1000000)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        distance.tss = DMPS.annot[i, "pos"][[1]] - start,
        CpG.id = DMPS.annot[i, "CpG.id"], # Add CpG.id for tracking
        CpG.relative.to.TSS = case_when(
          strand == "+" & distance.tss > 0 ~ "downstream",
          strand == "+" & distance.tss < 0 ~ "upstream",
          strand == "-" & distance.tss > 0 ~ "upstream",
          strand == "-" & distance.tss < 0 ~ "downstream",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_ # Handle cases where distance.tss == 0 or strand is not +/-
        ),
        Relation_to_Island = DMPS.annot[i, "Relation_to_Island"],
        Regulatory_Feature_Group = DMPS.annot[i, "Regulatory_Feature_Group"],
        chr = DMPS.annot[i, "chr"],
        pos = DMPS.annot[i, "pos"]
        
    )
    # %>% filter(TSS.location == "upstream")
    # Append the results to the dataframe
    df.genes.close.to.cpgs <- bind_rows(
      df.genes.close.to.cpgs,
      gene.selection
    )
  }
  
  return(df.genes.close.to.cpgs)
}

df.genes.close.to.cpgs <- find.near.genes(DMPs.SEO.annot)
df.genes.close.to.cpgs
```

```{r}
#DMPS.annot <- top10.DMPs.SEO.annot
DMPS.annot <- DMPs.SEO.annot

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpmisc)
library(readr)

# Set up output directory
result.dir <- "../../results/05_EQTm/assoc_CpG_GEX"
sig.dir <- file.path(result.dir, "1Mb_window_sig_CpG_GEX")
script.result.dir <- file.path(sig.dir, "fdr_sig_cpg_sig_CpG_GEX")
dir.create(script.result.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Precompute gene annotations
gene_annot <- df.genes.close.to.cpgs %>%
  distinct(ENS.ID, gene.symbol, chr, pos, distance.tss, 
           CpG.relative.to.TSS, Relation_to_Island, Regulatory_Feature_Group)

# Initialize results storage
df.sig.EQTm <- tibble(
  CpG = character(),
  GenesBeforeQC = integer(),
  GenesAfterQC = integer(),
  Sig.Genes = integer()
)
all_results <- list()

# Convert phenotype column to factor
pheno.data <- pheno.data %>%
  mutate(COPD_Y_or_N = as.factor(COPD_Y_or_N))

# ---- Helper Functions ----
prepare_data <- function(cpg, pheno.data, meth, betas, rna.expression) {
  # Combine phenotype with methylation data
  current.pheno.data <- pheno.data %>%
    as_tibble(rownames = "sample_id") %>%
    mutate(
      Methylation = meth[sample_id, cpg],
      Betas = betas[sample_id, cpg]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Methylation) & !is.na(Betas)) %>%
    arrange(match(GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq, colnames(rna.expression)))
  
  # Get nearby genes
  ENS.ID.to.use <- df.genes.close.to.cpgs %>%
    filter(CpG.id == cpg) %>%
    pull(ENS.ID) %>%
    unique()
  
  list(
    pheno = current.pheno.data,
    genes = ENS.ID.to.use
  )
}

run_eQTM_analysis <- function(rna_expression, pheno.data, cpg) {
  # Align samples
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(rna_expression), 
                            pheno.data$GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq)
  
  if (length(common_samples) < 3) {
    message("Skipping: Insufficient samples (", length(common_samples), ")")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Subset data to common samples
  rna_expression <- rna_expression[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  pheno.data <- pheno.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq %in% common_samples) %>%
    arrange(match(GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq, common_samples)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  # Filter low-expressed genes
  keep_genes <- rowSums(rna_expression > 0) >= 0.2 * ncol(rna_expression)
  rna_expression <- rna_expression[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (nrow(rna_expression) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Create design matrix
  design <- model.matrix(
    ~ Betas + Gender + Age + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7,
    data = pheno.data
  )
  
  # Check for rank deficiency
  if (qr(design)$rank < ncol(design)) {
    message("Rank-deficient design matrix")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # EdgeR processing
  DGEL <- DGEList(rna_expression)
  
  # Remove samples with zero library size
  keep_samples <- colSums(DGEL$counts) > 0
  if (any(!keep_samples)) {
    message("Removing ", sum(!keep_samples), " samples with zero library size")
    DGEL <- DGEL[, keep_samples]
    design <- design[keep_samples, ]
  }
  
  # Skip if insufficient samples remain
  if (ncol(DGEL) < 3) {
    message("Insufficient samples after filtering (", ncol(DGEL), ")")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Calculate normalization factors
  DGEL <- calcNormFactors(DGEL, method = "TMM")
  
  # Handle single gene case differently
  if (nrow(DGEL) == 1) {
    message("Single gene case - using logCPM instead of voom")
    logCPM <- cpm(DGEL, log = TRUE, prior.count = 3)
    
    # Use standard least squares for single gene
    fit <- lmFit(logCPM, design, method = "ls") %>%
      eBayes(robust = FALSE)
    
    # Create pseudo-voom object for plotting
    voom_data <- list(
      E = logCPM,
      weights = matrix(1, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(logCPM)),
      design = design
    )
  } else {
    # Multiple genes - use voom with robust regression
    voom_data <- voom(DGEL, design, plot = FALSE)
    
    # Increase maxit for robust regression to prevent convergence warnings
    fit <- lmFit(voom_data, design, method = "robust", maxit = 1000) %>%
      eBayes(proportion = 0.1, robust = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Extract results
  results <- topTable(fit, coef = "Betas", number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    rownames_to_column("geneID") %>%
    left_join(gene_annot, by = c("geneID" = "ENS.ID")) %>%
    mutate(CpG.id = cpg)
  
  # Return both results and expression data
  list(
    results = results,
    expr_data = voom_data
  )
}

generate_plot <- function(gene, cpg, analysis_result, pheno.data) {
  # Extract expression data from analysis result
  expr_data <- analysis_result$expr_data
  gene_symbol <- gene_annot$gene.symbol[gene_annot$ENS.ID == gene]
  
  # Create expression data frame
  expr_df <- data.frame(
    GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq = colnames(expr_data$E),
    RNA.expr = as.numeric(expr_data$E[gene, ])
  )
  
  plot_data <- pheno.data %>%
    left_join(expr_df, by = "GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq") %>%
    mutate(Methylation = Betas) %>%
    filter(!is.na(RNA.expr) & !is.na(Methylation))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  # Scatter plot
  scatter_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Methylation, y = RNA.expr)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = COPD_Y_or_N), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue") +
    stat_poly_eq(
      aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..adj.rr.label.., sep = "~~~")),
      formula = y ~ x, parse = TRUE, size = 5
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Methylation (Beta Value)",
      y = "log2 Expression",
      title = paste(gene_symbol, "Expression vs", cpg),
      color = "COPD Status"
    ) +
    theme_prism(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  
  # Boxplot
  box_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = COPD_Y_or_N, y = Methylation)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = COPD_Y_or_N), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), size = 1.5) +
    labs(x = "COPD Status", y = "Methylation (Beta Value)") +
    theme_prism(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  # Combine plots
  scatter_plot / box_plot + 
    plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste("eQTM:", gene_symbol, "and", cpg),
                    theme = theme_prism(base_size = 16))
}

# --------------------------- Main Loop ---------------------------------------#

for (i in seq_len(nrow(DMPS.annot))) {
  cpg <- DMPS.annot$CpG.id[i]
  cat("\nProcessing CpG:", cpg, paste0("[", i, "/", nrow(DMPS.annot), "]"), "\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    # Step 1: Prepare data
    data_prep <- prepare_data(cpg, pheno.data, meth, betas, rna.expression)
    current.pheno.data <- data_prep$pheno
    ENS.ID.to.use <- data_prep$genes
    
    # Skip if no genes nearby
    if (length(ENS.ID.to.use) == 0) {
      cat("No genes near CpG. Skipping.\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Step 2: Subset RNA expression
    rna_expression_current <- rna.expression[ENS.ID.to.use, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Step 3: Run analysis
    analysis_result <- run_eQTM_analysis(rna_expression_current, current.pheno.data, cpg)
    
    if (is.null(analysis_result)) {
      cat("Analysis failed. Skipping.\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Extract results
    results <- analysis_result$results
    sig_results <- results %>% 
      filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% ##### P.Value or adj.P.Val !!!!!!!!!!!!!
      arrange( P.Value)
    
    # Update summary statistics
    df.sig.EQTm <- df.sig.EQTm %>%
      add_row(
        CpG = cpg,
        GenesBeforeQC = length(ENS.ID.to.use),
        GenesAfterQC = nrow(results),
        Sig.Genes = nrow(sig_results)
      )
    
    cat("Significant genes:", nrow(sig_results), 
        "/", nrow(results), "\n")
    
    # Step 5: Save and plot significant results
    if (nrow(sig_results) > 0) {
      # Create output directory
      cpg_dir <- file.path(script.result.dir, cpg)
      dir.create(cpg_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
      
      # Save results
      write_csv(results, file.path(cpg_dir, paste0(cpg, "_full_results.csv")))
      write_csv(sig_results, file.path(cpg_dir, paste0(cpg, "_significant_results.csv")))
      
      # Generate and save plots
      for (gene in sig_results$geneID) {
        plot <- generate_plot(gene, cpg, analysis_result, current.pheno.data)
        if (!is.null(plot)) {
          ggsave(
            filename = file.path(
              cpg_dir,
              paste0(cpg, "_", gene_annot$gene.symbol[gene_annot$ENS.ID == gene], "_plot.png")
            ),
            plot = plot,
            width = 10,
            height = 12,
            dpi = 300
          )
        }
      }
      
      # Store results
      all_results[[cpg]] <- sig_results
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("\nERROR processing ", cpg, ": ", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  })
}

# ---- Final Output ----
# Combine all results
final_results <- bind_rows(all_results)

# Save summary statistics
write_csv(df.sig.EQTm, file.path(script.result.dir, "eQTM_summary_statistics_fdr_pval.csv"))
write_csv(final_results, file.path(script.result.dir, "significant_CpG_GEX.csv"))
```

```{r}
  # Extract expression data from analysis result
  expr_data <- analysis_result$expr_data
  gene_symbol <- gene_annot$gene.symbol[gene_annot$ENS.ID == gene]
  
  # Create expression data frame
  expr_df <- data.frame(
    GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq = colnames(expr_data$E),
    RNA.expr = as.numeric(expr_data$E[gene, ])
  )
  
  plot_data <- pheno.data %>%
    left_join(expr_df, by = "GenomeScan_ID_RNAseq") %>%
    mutate(Methylation = Betas) %>%
    filter(!is.na(RNA.expr) & !is.na(Methylation))
  
  if (nrow(plot_data) < 3) return(NULL)
  
  # Convert COPD_Y_or_N to meaningful labels
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(Condition = ifelse(COPD_Y_or_N == "COPD", "COPD", "Control"),
           Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("COPD", "Control")))
  
  # Define colors for conditions
  condition_colors <- c("COPD" = "#E41A1C", "Control" = "#377EB8")
  
  # Scatter plot with enhanced styling
  scatter_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Methylation, y = RNA.expr)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Condition), 
               size = 4, 
               alpha = 0.9,
               shape = 21,           # Circle with fill and border
               color = "black",      # Border color
               stroke = 1.2) +       # Border thickness
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
    stat_poly_eq(
      aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..adj.rr.label.., sep = "~~~")),
      formula = y ~ x, 
      parse = TRUE, 
      size = 5,
      vjust = 0.01,        # Move equation upward (positive values move up)
      hjust = -0.9  
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "Methylation (Beta Value)",
      y = "logCPM(Expression)",
      title = paste(gene_symbol, "Expression vs", cpg),
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 25),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Boxplot with enhanced styling
  box_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Condition, y = Methylation)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Condition), 
                 alpha = 0.9,
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                 width = 0.6) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      aes(fill = Condition),
      dodge.width = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.9,
      size = 3,
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Methylation (Beta Value)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_plot <- scatter_plot / box_plot + 
    plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste("eQTM:", gene_symbol, "and", cpg),
      theme = theme_minimal()
    )
  
  return(combined_plot)
}
```
